A little piece of Dubai in Montenegro: Where luxury meets the wild

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Croatia is stepping up pressure on Montenegro over a border dispute as an EU accession deadline looms. [1]
Climate change is redrawing Montenegro's winemaking map. [2]

KEY RISKS
Montenegro is linked to 7 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether Croatia and Montenegro will resolve their border dispute before the EU accession deadline. [1]
Whether the InterContinental luxury resort will open in Montenegro in 2029 as announced. [5]
